user.title: Add vehicle
user.description: Choose a BMW preset or BEV for a manufacturer-neutral battery electric vehicle. Any number of vehicles can be configured.

vehicle.title: Vehicle sensors
vehicle.description: Select the vehicle's Home Assistant source sensors. The energy/capacity sensor must represent the battery's total usable capacity, not the current stored energy. For BEV, a fixed usable battery capacity can be entered instead. If latitude and longitude are configured, Cardata Analytics can resolve the current address through OpenStreetMap Nominatim and provides a Google Maps link without a Google API key.

data.energy_entity: Usable battery / HV capacity (optional for BEV)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cardata Analytics
reconfigure.description: Change source sensors or vehicle name. Optional GPS latitude/longitude sensors can be added or changed here.

error.capacity_source_required: For BEV, select a usable-capacity sensor or enter a fixed usable battery capacity.
error.gps_pair_required: Configure both latitude and longitude sensors, or leave both empty.

abort.global_entry_managed: The global comparison period is managed automatically by Cardata Analytics.
